description: Look up Adobe Commerce Web API: REST endpoints (path, method, parameters, body, which tokens can call it) from the official OpenAPI schema, and GraphQL queries and mutations (arguments, return type, example, guide). Accepts a GraphQL name, a REST path or keywords. Use it when writing integrations or storefront calls.

query.description: GraphQL query or mutation name (e.g. "products", "addProductsToCart"), REST path (e.g. "/V1/products/{sku}", "V1/orders"), or keywords (e.g. "cart coupon", "customer address")

name: lookup-webapi
title: Look up REST endpoints and GraphQL operations
